title: feat: HTTP management client — health, explain, profile, snapshot, WAL
body:
`LoraDbClient` only exposed `/query`. This adds `LoraDbHttpManagementClient` covering the full `lora-server` HTTP surface.

## New client

`ILoraDbHttpManagementClient` extends `ILoraDbClient` (CRUD/batch/typed streaming still work):

```csharp
await using var mgmt = LoraDbHttpManagementClient.Create(new Uri("http://127.0.0.1:4747/"));

var health  = await mgmt.HealthAsync();                          // GET  /health
var plan    = await mgmt.ExplainAsync("MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p"); // POST /explain  — never executes
var profile = await mgmt.ProfileAsync("MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p"); // POST /profile  — runs for real

// opt-in admin (require --snapshot-path / --wal-dir on the server)
var meta    = await mgmt.SaveSnapshotAsync("/backup/db.bin");    // POST /admin/snapshot/save
var status  = await mgmt.WalStatusAsync();                       // POST /admin/wal/status
await mgmt.TruncateWalAsync(fenceLsn: status.DurableLsn);       // POST /admin/wal/truncate
```

## New types

| Type | Returned by |
|---|---|
| `LoraDbHealthResult` | `HealthAsync` |
| `LoraDbQueryPlan` + `LoraDbPlanNode` | `ExplainAsync`, `ProfileAsync` |
| `LoraDbQueryProfile` + `LoraDbQueryMetrics` + `LoraDbOperatorMetrics` | `ProfileAsync` |
| `LoraDbSnapshotMeta` | `SaveSnapshotAsync`, `LoadSnapshotAsync`, `CheckpointAsync` |
| `LoraDbWalStatus` | `WalStatusAsync` |

## Implementation

- Management methods added to `HttpLoraDbTransport` (shared `HttpClient` + serializer options); `LoraDbHttpManagementClient` is a thin delegate wrapper.
- Admin routes with no payload send no body; `TruncateWalAsync` handles `204 No Content`.
- `netstandard2.1` compatible (`init` avoided, `ReadAsStreamAsync(ct)` guarded).
- 39 new unit tests via `RecordingHttpHandler`.
